map.Codabar（又称 NW-7）是一种离散、自校验的一维条形码，常用于血库、图书: Codabar (also known as NW-7) is a discrete, self-checking linear barcode widely used for fixed-length numbering in blood banks, libraries, courier services, and access control. This tool runs entirely in your browser — enter the characters and start/stop codes to draw the barcode in real time, with one-click copy.
map.字符集：0–9、- $ : / . + 与起止符 A B C D: Character set: 0–9, - $ : / . + and the start/stop codes A B C D
map.编码：每字符 4 条 3 空，宽窄二值编码: Encoding: 4 bars and 3 spaces per character in a two-width (wide/narrow) scheme
map.Codabar 又称 NW-7，是离散自校验条码：每个字符独立编码为 4 条 +: Codabar, also called NW-7, is a discrete self-checking barcode: each character is encoded independently as 4 bars and 3 spaces (7 elements in total, 2 or 3 of them wide), with characters separated by a narrow space. Its character set covers only the digits 0–9, the symbols - $ : / . +, and the start/stop codes A/B/C/D (also seen as T/N/*/E). It carries no check digit, so reliability rests on the validity of each character's own encoding — which suits libraries, blood banks, and courier forms whose numbers have a fixed length and can be verified by hand.
map.血库与图书馆标签：Codabar 长期用于血袋编号、图书馆馆藏号与快递运单，字符: Blood bank and library labels: Codabar has long been used for blood bag numbers, library call numbers, and courier waybills. Its simple character set works with low-cost printers and suits fixed-length numbers that need manual verification.
map.老系统对接：许多医院的检验科与物流系统仍用 Codabar，读到的串以 A/B/: Legacy system integration: many hospital laboratories and logistics systems still use Codabar. Scanned strings begin and end with A/B/C/D, so parsing must strip the start/stop characters before reading the payload.
map.输入数字串（如 `123456789`）→ 渲染 CODABAR 条码图形；请按: Enter a numeric string (e.g. `123456789`) → renders a CODABAR barcode image; follow the prescribed length and check-digit rules.
map.Codabar 有校验位吗？: Does Codabar have a check digit?
map.标准 Codabar 不含校验位，可靠性依赖字符编码的合法性——扫描器遇到非法编: Standard Codabar has no check digit; reliability rests on the validity of each character's encoding — a scanner rejects illegal codes outright. If higher reliability is required, append a Mod 16 or Luhn check digit to the number and verify it on the application side.
map.为什么读出来的号码带了字母？: Why does the scanned number include letters?
map.A/B/C/D（部分设备显示为 T/N/*/E）是 Codabar 的起止符，本: A/B/C/D (shown as T/N/*/E on some devices) are Codabar's start/stop characters, not data. If you only need the numeric part, strip one character from each end when parsing; some scanners can be configured to drop the start/stop characters automatically.
